name: lemma
description: Lemma's own plugins. Telepath connects your existing Telegram conversations to Claude over a hosted MCP server.

plugins.name: lemma-telepath
plugins.description: Your Telegram, inside Claude. Search archived chats, read files and voice transcripts, and reply when permitted. After installing, open Telepath → Connectors → Add or Connect and sign in with Telegram. Follow the device setup guide to receive new messages. No Telegram Premium required.
